selection_rationale: Phase 2 follows the predeclared Phase 1 promotion logic without selecting a single winning timeframe: the complete Donchian scale-transfer sibling family DH-02/DH-03 is carried forward jointly because DH-02 satisfied all frozen gates and DH-03 remained positive but sample-limited. EMA and PBR are not carried forward because their independent Phase 1 economics were negative.

validation_dataset.listing_aware_policy: A monthly archive absent before a symbol's first official available Binance Spot monthly archive is recorded as PRE_LISTING_UNAVAILABLE and is not filled. After first availability, any later missing monthly archive inside 2019-2020 is SOURCE_GAP_BLOCKED. No alternate provider, synthetic fill, interpolation or cross-exchange backfill is allowed.
validation_dataset.canonicalization: Aggregate only complete consecutive 1m observations into UTC-aligned 15m bars. Incomplete 15m buckets are dropped. Higher-timeframe continuity is split across gaps.

family_interpretation: Both cells must always be reported. No post-outcome winner timeframe may be selected. A cell surviving validation is evidence for that frozen cell only; it does not authorize live trading or a diamond claim.
freeze_statement: Rules, universe, costs, listing-aware source policy, sample floor and both validation cells are frozen before any Phase 2 source acquisition or outcome evaluation.
